    # Vertical columns at x=6.3 and x=13.7 (1.3m from core center)
    col_left = sandbox.add_beam(x=6.3, y=4.0, width=0.4, height=0.4, density=1.0)
    col_mid = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=4.0, width=0.4, height=0.4, density=1.0)
    col_right = sandbox.add_beam(x=13.7, y=4.0, width=0.4, height=0.4, density=1.0)
    
    # Connect vertical columns to ground
    sandbox.add_joint(col_left, None, (6.3, 0.0), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(col_mid, None, (10.0, 0.0), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(col_right, None, (13.7, 0.0), type='rigid')
    
    # Horizontal beams at different heights to distribute force
    # Lower beam (y=4.0)
    beam_low = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=4.0, width=7.4, height=0.4, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(col_left, beam_low, (6.3, 4.0), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(col_mid, beam_low, (10.0, 4.0), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(col_right, beam_low, (13.7, 4.0), type='rigid')
    
    # Middle beam (y=6.0)
    beam_mid = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=6.0, width=7.4, height=0.4, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(col_left, beam_mid, (6.3, 6.0), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(col_mid, beam_mid, (10.0, 6.0), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(col_right, beam_mid, (13.7, 6.0), type='rigid')
    
    # Upper beam (y=7.5) to absorb high-impact boulders
    beam_high = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=7.5, width=7.4, height=0.4, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(col_left, beam_high, (6.3, 7.5), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(col_mid, beam_high, (10.0, 7.5), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(col_right, beam_high, (13.7, 7.5), type='rigid')
    
    # Diagonal braces to distribute load and reduce torque
    # Left to middle diagonal brace (from left column top to middle beam top)
    diag_left_mid = sandbox.add_beam(x=8.15, y=5.2, width=0.4, height=0.4, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(col_left, diag_left_mid, (6.3, 4.2), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(beam_mid, diag_left_mid, (10.0, 6.2), type='rigid')
    
    # Middle to right diagonal brace (from middle column top to right beam top)
    diag_mid_right = sandbox.add_beam(x=11.85, y=5.2, width=0.4, height=0.4, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(col_mid, diag_mid_right, (10.0, 4.2), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(beam_high, diag_mid_right, (13.7, 7.7), type='rigid')
    
    # Left to right diagonal brace (from left column top to right beam top)
    diag_left_right = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=6.0, width=0.4, height=0.4, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(col_left, diag_left_right, (6.3, 4.2), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(beam_high, diag_left_right, (13.7, 7.7), type='rigid')
    
    return col_left
